Replace ONLY the blue ASCII black hole occupying the left half with a pair of enormous curly braces { } constructed entirely from visible tiny monospaced ASCII characters (letters, numbers, slash, backslash, dot, colon, dash). The paired brace silhouette reads {} with white empty centre. Match the original electric blue #245BFF, fine character grid, pale blue peripheral shading, and white background. Keep artwork exclusively in left 46% of canvas. Preserve the right side EXACTLY: wordmark 'the next {something}', same Departure Mono pixel typography, black words and blue punctuation, position and size; bottom line '50+ launches for' with original Y Combinator and a16z/speedrun logos, exact colours/spacing. No black hole, rings, orb, stars, extra words, labels, shadows, watermark, or new logos. The ASCII must be actual recognisable small characters, NOT dots or solid-filled braces. Variant CLEAN: front-facing upright balanced braces, sharp elegant curly contours, height 76% of canvas, each brace about 10% canvas width, pair centred at x=24%, y=50%. Entire pair visible with generous whitespace around it. Medium character density, crisp detailed blue characters with restrained pale blue edge shading. No trail, no perspective, no clipping.
